selection.rule: mean calibration recall, then mean AP, then smaller training size; lexical tie-break

target.assessment: both point targets must hold for every fitted classical seed on internal test

improvement_reference: same-size majority baseline on identical internal test rows
target_scope: internal PhiUSIIL only; external continuity evidence is reported separately

selected_confidence_intervals.method: paired percentile row bootstrap of the mean metric across fitted seeds

limitations: Historical PhiUSIIL data and host-only features do not establish performance on current attacks.
Internal partitions are domain-disjoint but share one collection process; historical feature choices informed v2.
The external dataset has already informed project decisions; it is secondary continuity evidence, not a new untouched test.
Bootstrap intervals describe test-example uncertainty conditional on fitted models; seed dispersion is reported separately.
Calibration is used for threshold and configuration selection; its metrics are not held-out performance estimates.
Quantum results are exact CPU simulation; there is no claim of quantum speedup or advantage.
Quantum searches nine configurations per map and eighteen across both maps; classical families search six each.
Fresh independently collected, preferably temporal data is required before operational adoption.
next_experiment: Evaluate hostname character representations under a new frozen protocol, then validate on newly collected temporal data.
